name: Medical imaging center (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound)

pf.license.need: Optional, and nothing is required by Rosie. The center may list its own records on its page: each machine's state registration, the federal mammography certificate, accreditations, and each technologist's credential and the supervising radiologist. Rosie shows what the center enters, as given.
pf.license.ask: Optional: each machine's registration and end date; the mammography certificate; accreditations; each technologist's credential; the supervising radiologists' names.
pf.license.who holds it: The center (its machines and certificates); each technologist; each radiologist.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie does not check, look up or verify any license, registration, certificate or credential (D96). The center's own word only.
pf.license.blocks going live: None for a license: nothing is held back because a machine, certificate or credential is not on the page.
pf.license.renewals: None tracked by Rosie; the center keeps its own dates.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Optional: the center may list its malpractice or liability insurance; Rosie does not check it.
pf.license.background check: The center's own choice; Rosie does not run one.
pf.license.own word: If the center says an exam needs a credential a technologist doesn't have, that technologist isn't offered for that exam (the center's own word, not a check).

pf.services.shape: Imaging center: exams on a doctor's order, each booked as a room and its machine with a qualified technologist; a walk-in X-ray on an order; mobile X-ray and ultrasound at homes and care facilities; a mammography coach day on set days at a workplace or community site with the host's standing OK.
pf.services.examples: The example center's own self-pay prices, not a standard. A plan pays its own share; the share is billed by the center its own way.

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: On a secure link: fasting or a full bladder as the exam needs; no metal or jewelry for MRI; no deodorant for a mammogram; the order, a photo ID and the plan card; a driver if calming medicine is taken.
pf.first_steps.prep timing: Fasting starts 4 to 8 hours before; for a morning exam that means from the night before. The prep link goes in the confirmation whenever the prep starts before the next reminder.

pf.visit.check-in: The code at the desk. A walk-in X-ray: a place in the line with the order. Mobile: the code at the door, or the facility's nurse at the front desk.
pf.visit.at the visit: The technologist checks the order, the identity, the safety form and pregnancy again before any exam. A chaperone is offered for intimate exams.
pf.visit.work changes: An exam the order doesn't name is never added; a new or changed order comes from the doctor first.
pf.visit.stops: A pregnancy, an implant not cleared, missed fasting, or no driver after calming medicine: that exam doesn't go ahead; another time, with no fee.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the images are taken.
pf.visit.results: A radiologist reads the images and the report goes to the ordering doctor through the center's own system, usually within 1 to 2 business days. The patient's own copy comes through the center's patient portal under the federal rules; for a mammogram, the federal mammography letter goes to the patient. Rosie never texts a result.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken (the starting answer). A self-pay patient may pay the self-pay price in full when booking, after the written estimate.
pf.money.after: The plan is billed by the center its own way; the patient's share is billed by the center after the plan pays, or a copay is paid at the desk. A care facility's residents under its contract: billed the business's own way.
pf.money.estimate: A self-pay or uninsured patient gets a written good-faith estimate when booking, where the federal rule applies.
pf.money.fees: No late-cancel or no-show fee, for anyone.
pf.money.rosfield: Rosfield's $2 per booking applies as for every business (D97); the center pays it, never the patient.

pf.messages.never in a text: The exam, the body part, the order's reason, pregnancy, implants, contrast, results. Texts name only the center, the date, the time and the place; staff and owner texts use initials and a secure link.
pf.messages.results: Never in a text; 'your doctor has the report' at most, only where the patient agreed.
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish, plus the center's interpreter line.
pf.messages.minors: A parent or guardian books; texts go to them.

pf.staff.roles: Radiologic technologists, CT and MRI technologists, sonographers, mammography technologists, an MRI safety technologist, radiologists (reading and supervising), front desk.
pf.staff.supervision: A contrast exam is offered only while a supervising radiologist or doctor is on site.
pf.staff.skills: each technologist's kinds of exam, as the center lists them
pf.staff.who OKs: The MRI safety technologist reads every MRI safety form; the radiologist OKs a past contrast reaction.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another technologist with the same skill. A patient who asked for a female technologist is asked before anyone else does the exam; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.chaperone: Offered for every intimate exam; a patient's request is honored.

pf.rules.orders: No exam without the order it needs, except a screening mammogram where the state's rules allow it without one.
pf.rules.health privacy: The center signs Rosie's health-privacy agreement before going live.
pf.rules.radiation: Pregnancy screening before X-ray and CT for anyone who could be pregnant.
pf.rules.results: Reports go to the ordering doctor; the patient's copy by the federal rules; the mammography letter by the federal rule.
pf.rules.records: Images and reports kept as long as the state's and federal rules require (mammograms at least 5 years), in the center's own system; booking records 7 years. A patient's copy within 30 days.
pf.rules.estimates: A written good-faith estimate for self-pay patients, where the federal rule applies.

matter most.no order on the day: The desk calls the doctor's office; no order, no exam, no fee.
matter most.prior approval not back: Self-pay with a yes, or a move with no fee.
matter most.could be pregnant: Stopped until the ordering doctor says.
matter most.implant not cleared: Not scanned; the doctor is told to order another exam.
matter most.no driver after calming medicine: The exam waits, or goes ahead without the medicine if the patient wants.
matter most.a child: A parent stays; a pregnant parent waits outside the X-ray room.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
